title: India's Para Athletes Win 7 Medals at CWG 2026
summary: The 28-member Indian para sports contingent participated in the Glasgow Commonwealth Games 2026, winning seven medals including three gold, two silver, and two bronze. The team's performance was led by athletes who claimed to have broken records in their respective events. Indian officials said they were proud of the team's achievement, while opposition members alleged that the government had not provided sufficient support for para-athletes. Police claimed that there were no major incidents during the games.
summary_points: The Indian para sports contingent won seven medals at CWG 2026.
Three gold, two silver, and two bronze medals were awarded to Indian athletes.
The team's performance was led by athletes who broke records in their respective events.
title_hi: ग्लासगो कॉमनवेल्थ गेम्स 2026 में भारतीय पैरा एथलीटों ने 7 पदक जीते
summary_hi: ग्लासगो कॉमनवेल्थ गेम्स 2026 में, 28 सदस्यीय भारतीय पैरा खेलों की टीम ने अपने अभियान को सात पदकों से समाप्त किया, जिसमें तीन स्वर्ण, दो रजत और दो कांस्य पदक शामिल थे। टीम के प्रदर्शन में एथलीटों ने अपने व्यक्तिगत आयोजनों में रिकॉर्ड तोड़े, जिसने उनकी सफलता को बढ़ावा दिया। भारतीय अधिकारियों ने टीम की उपलब्धि पर गर्व महसूस किया, जबकि विपक्षी सदस्यों ने कहा कि सरकार ने पैरा-एथलीटों के लिए पर्याप्त समर्थन नहीं दिया। पुलिस ने माना कि गेम्स में बड़े घटनाक्रम नहीं हुए।
summary_points_hi: ग्लासगो कॉमनवेल्थ गेम्स 2026 में, भारतीय पैरा खेलों की टीम ने सात पदक जीते।

framing.left: Indian officials said they were proud of the team's achievement, while opposition members alleged that the government had not provided sufficient support for para-athletes. Police claimed that there were no major incidents during the games.
